subject.title: improve(ui): inset secret-input reveal everywhere — login gate and config form adopt the settings pattern

question: After refreshing this protected visual follow-up onto current main, should maintainers accept the shared inset reveal treatment for login and configuration secrets?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the current branch is behind main even though the stated direction follows the recently merged settings pattern.

options.title: Refresh, visually verify, and merge
options.body: Rebase onto current main and confirm that login fields, string secret inputs, and JSON secret textareas preserve reveal and disabled behavior before merging.

options.title: Keep the existing separate control treatment
options.body: Decline the follow-up if maintainers want login or configuration secrets to remain visually distinct from the Connection settings pattern.

recommendation.title: Refresh, visually verify, and merge
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main and confirm that login fields, string secret inputs, and JSON secret textareas preserve reveal and disabled behavior before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent merged secret-input design pattern and authored this focused follow-up.
